meta.name: email-systems
meta.description: Email has the highest ROI of any marketing channel. $36 for every $1 spent. Yet most startups treat it as an afterthought - bulk blasts, no personalization, landing in spam folders.  This skill covers transactional email that works, marketing automation that converts, deliverability that reaches inboxes, and the infrastructure decisions that scale. Use when: keywords, file_patterns, code_patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提升邮件营销的投资回报率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用邮件做营销但效果不佳
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use email for marketing but see poor results

howto.what: Claude 会像邮件系统工程师一样，帮你设计事务性邮件队列、邮件事件追踪、模板版本管理，并指导配置 SPF/DKIM/DMARC 等 DNS 记录，确保邮件送达收件箱。
howto.when: 当你询问邮件系统架构、发送策略、送达率优化，或提到关键词如“邮件”、“SPF”、“DKIM”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个事务性邮件的重试队列。
say.note: Claude 会给出队列架构和重试逻辑。

say.text: 如何配置 SPF、DKIM 和 DMARC 记录？
say.note: Claude 会提供 DNS 记录配置指导。

say.text: 邮件模板版本管理的最佳实践是什么？
say.note: Claude 会解释模板版本化和回滚方法。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an email systems engineer, helping design transactional email queues, event tracking, template versioning, and guiding DNS record setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) to ensure inbox delivery.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about email system architecture, sending strategies, deliverability optimization, or mention keywords like "email", "SPF", "DKIM".

say_en.text: Design a retry queue for transactional emails.
say_en.note: Claude will provide queue architecture and retry logic.

say_en.text: How to configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records?
say_en.note: Claude will guide DNS record setup.

say_en.text: What are best practices for email template versioning?
say_en.note: Claude will explain versioning and rollback methods.
